item.arcanestaves.fire_staff.desc: Launches a fireball that burns targets and ignites flammable blocks.
item.arcanestaves.swap_staff.desc: Fires an echo bolt that swaps places with the target. Missing costs no durability.
item.arcanestaves.singularity_staff.desc: Creates a gravity anomaly that drags enemies in, then collapses in a shockwave.
message.arcanestaves.swap_blocked: There is no room to swap places!
